description: OLE-ACCESS immediate versus deferred validation: Commands with Prepared False/True and text 'SELEC bad', a missing table, and a valid parameter marker, where Prepared and CommandText are set, then Parameters.Count is read (forcing parameter description) in some cases, then Execute; after each step the Connection Errors are read. A prepared Command with valid text is executed, its text changed to another valid text and executed again, then changed to bad text and executed, then back. Asks at which call each error first surfaces and whether re-execution after a text change re-describes.
